snippet.title: [LGAV] - ATHENS ELEFTHERIOS VENIZELOS Intl. Airport by FlyTampa for Tower! Simulator 3
snippet.description:
https://feelthere.com/shop/advertising/athens-airport-tower-simulator-3/

About:

Athens Airport is the perfect setting for Tower!, where classic European complexity meets Mediterranean charm. With a constant variety of airlines and traffic from all corners of Europe, Asia, Africa, and North America, LGAV keeps controllers busy.

Set against the stunning backdrop of the Aegean Sea, Athens becomes a challenging yet incredibly rewarding airport to control in Tower!: strategic, dynamic, and never boring.

Features:

- Custom modelled buildings that capture the unique architecture of LGAV.
- A meticulously detailed ground polygon model.
- Taxi signs and 3D taxi lights.
- Realistic runway approach lighting.
- Stunning background scenery crafted from OpenStreetMap (OSM) data, creating an immersive landscape around the airport.
- An intuitive radar display that keeps you connected with all aircraft movements, making your air traffic control duties more engaging.
